method: UI in Claude in Chrome session, the test account, pt-BR. Wizard walked to step 3 and abandoned with 'Sair'. Nothing was saved.
steps_run: Opened Aplicativos > Webhooks (/app-store/webhooks), tab 'Webhooks'; toggle 'Webhook de saída' / 'Webhook de entrada' (inbound is plan-gated)
Pressed 'Adicionar webhook': a type picker (outbound or inbound) opened; chose outbound; URL became /webhooks/outbound/create
Step 1 'Criar webhook de saída': field 'Nome' (required, max 64 characters)
Step 2 'Ponto de extremidade': field 'URL' (required), select 'Método de autenticação' (Sem autenticação, Básico, Token), link '+ Adicionar objeto' (extra headers, inferred from the label)
Step 3 'Ações': single select 'Categoria de evento' (15 categories) then one on/off toggle per event, all on by default; final button 'Ativar webhook'; 'Cancelar' asks 'Descartar alterações?'
results: Webhook list still empty afterwards (nothing created)
109 outbound events across 15 categories captured in inventory/webhook_events.json
limitations: No webhook was created, so the response, the resulting ID and the webhook detail page were not observed.
The mapping between the UI field 'Nome' and the API field 'description' is inferred.
The 15 UI categories do not map one-to-one to the 3 API types (transactional, marketing, inbound) and the event label to API enum mapping is only partly known.
Creating a live webhook would start sending contact data to the chosen URL, so it was not run without a URL under the account owner's control.
